mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 3.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 3.0% (over a 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 3.5% signals monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.5% (over a 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 2.5%, the economy is in a recessionary labor market with accommodative monetary policy, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: recessionary labor market with monetary accommodation
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS < 2.5% (over a 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5% (over a 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 2200 thousand units indicate strong economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 2200 (over a 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 2100 thousand units indicate a weakening housing market, which signals economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when HOUST < 2100 (over a 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is rising and real GDP (GDPC1) is above 10900 billion dollars, the economy is in a strong expansion phase, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO > 118.0 and GDPC1 > 10900.0 (over a 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL YoY inflation > 2.5%), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY inflation > 2.5% (over a 5-year rolling window).
